command:
set -eu
usermod -a -G prometheus thanos
cat > /etc/thanos/objstore.yml <<'OBJSTORE_EOF'
type: S3
config:
  bucket: thanos-metrics
  endpoint: node4:9000
  access_key: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY}
  secret_key: [REDACTED]}
  insecure: false
  signature_version2: false
  bucket_lookup_type: path
  http_config:
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/thanos/tls/ca.crt
      insecure_skip_verify: false
OBJSTORE_EOF
chown root:thanos /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-sidecar.service <<'SIDECAR_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Thanos sidecar for the local Prometheus
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target prometheus.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=thanos
Group=thanos
SupplementaryGroups=prometheus
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/thanos sidecar --http-address=0.0.0.0:10902 --grpc-address=0.0.0.0:10901 --prometheus.url=http://127.0.0.1:9090 --tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus --objstore.config-file=/etc/thanos/objstore.yml --shipper.upload-compacted
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full
CapabilityBoundingSet=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
SIDECAR_UNIT_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now thanos-sidecar
systemctl is-active thanos-sidecar
ss -tlnp | grep -E ':10901|:10902' || true

set -eu
install -d -o thanos -g thanos -m 0750 /var/lib/thanos /var/lib/thanos/store /var/lib/thanos/compact
cat > /etc/thanos/objstore.yml <<'OBJSTORE_EOF'
type: S3
config:
  bucket: thanos-metrics
  endpoint: node4:9000
  access_key: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY}
  secret_key: [REDACTED]}
  insecure: false
  signature_version2: false
  bucket_lookup_type: path
  http_config:
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/thanos/tls/ca.crt
      insecure_skip_verify: false
OBJSTORE_EOF
chown root:thanos /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-store.service <<'STORE_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Thanos store gateway
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=thanos
Group=thanos
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/thanos store --http-address=0.0.0.0:10904 --grpc-address=0.0.0.0:10903 --data-dir=/var/lib/thanos/store --objstore.config-file=/etc/thanos/objstore.yml --consistency-delay=0s
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/thanos
CapabilityBoundingSet=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
STORE_UNIT_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-compact.service <<'COMPACT_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Thanos compactor
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=thanos
Group=thanos

RestartSec=10
LimitNOFILE=65536
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/thanos
CapabilityBoundingSet=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
COMPACT_UNIT_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-query.service <<'QUERY_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Thanos query endpoint
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target thanos-store.service
Wants=thanos-store.service

[Service]
Type=simple

Group=thanos
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/thanos query --http-address=0.0.0.0:10902 --grpc-address=0.0.0.0:10901 --endpoint=node1:10901 --endpoint=node2:10901 --endpoint=node3:10903 --query.replica-label=replica --query.timeout=2m --store.response-timeout=30s
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
NoNewPrivileges=true

ProtectHome=true

CapabilityBoundingSet=

WantedBy=multi-user.target

sleep 2
systemctl is-active thanos-store

systemctl is-active thanos-query

set -eu
{
  printf '%s\n' 'type: S3' 'config:' '  bucket: thanos-metrics' '  endpoint: node4:9000'

} > /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chown root:thanos /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
if [ "$NODE_NAME" = node3 ]; then
  sed -i 's/--endpoint=node3:10903/--endpoint=10.100.191.12:10903/' /etc/systemd/system/thanos-query.service
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl restart thanos-store thanos-compact thanos-query
else
  systemctl restart thanos-sidecar
fi
sleep 2
systemctl is-active thanos-sidecar 2>/dev/null || true
